title: Change the request of my running task
description: When the person adjusts the task you are doing (more or fewer fields, another range, order, filter or count, a correction), call this instead of starting a new task: the task, its card, tab group, pages, wizards and runs stay, and the person sees the new request.
guidance: A whole new job, usually on a new web page or site, is a new task: start it with a new taskDescription instead. Pass the whole new request as taskDescription, the person's own words as instruction, and for a continue task optionally the new taskSteps (steps already reported keep their state). Name the task by one of its pages; without pageContextId it amends your only running task.

inputSchema.description: The task and its new request.

pageContextId.description: A page belonging to the task; omit when you have one running task.

taskDescription.description: The whole request as it stands now, in detail and in the person's terms (not only the change); no credentials.

instruction.description: What the person said to change it, in their own words; shown on the task card as the change.

taskSteps.description: A continue task only: your new list of steps in order; steps already reported keep their state.

outputSchema.description: The task, still running, with its new request.

taskId.description: The task (its agent session, the card the person sees); taskNotice.previousTaskId names tasks the same way.

amendments.description: How often the task's request was changed so far.

steps.description: A continue task: its steps in order.

current.description: True for the step started last.
